evidence_reasoning: This cites prior physiological recording studies that appear to conflict with current findings.

claim: The discrepancy between population-level analysis and single-cell recording may be due to the sparse activity of dentate granule cells.
source_text: However, the discrepancy between our population-level analysis and the single-cell recording may be due to the sparse activity of DGCs
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative explanation for the apparent discrepancy between studies.

claim: Only a small percentage of dentate granule cells are active at any given time.
source_text: only a small percentage of DGCs are active at any given time
evidence_reasoning: This is known from the literature and consistent with the sparse labeling observed in the study.

claim: Physiological recordings may have sampled from a biased population of dentate granule cells that are more active than the general population.
source_text: it is possible that the physiological recordings may have sampled from a biased population of DGCs that are more active than the general population
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative explanation for methodological differences between studies.

claim: Adult-born dentate granule cells are more active than mature granule cells.
source_text: For example, adult-born DGCs are more active than mature granule cells (Kee et al., 2007)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior work on the activity properties of adult-born neurons.

claim: The majority of BrdU-positive cells are located close to the hilus.
source_text: Frequency distribution showing that the majority of the BrdU-positive cells are located close to the hilus
evidence_reasoning: This is an observation from BrdU labeling experiments.

claim: Both LacZ-positive and EGR1-positive populations were distributed across the granule cell layer.
source_text: whereas both LacZ-positive and EGR1-positive populations were distributed across the granule cell layer
evidence_reasoning: This is an observation from spatial distribution analysis.

claim: The distance from the hilus is significantly shorter in BrdU-positive cells compared to EGR1-positive or LacZ-positive cells.
source_text: The distance from the hilus is significantly shorter in BrdU-positive cells compared to that of the EGR1-positive or LacZ-positive cells
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative finding from spatial analysis.

claim: Adult-born neurons do not seem to be preferentially activated in the current study.
source_text: suggesting that adult-born neurons do not seem to be preferentially activated in our study
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the different spatial distributions of BrdU-labeled vs activity-labeled cells.

claim: When mice experience two different events, there is an elevation in the reactivation level of the dentate granule cell population that was activated during the initial event learning, although this level did not rise above chance.
source_text: Compared with the situation when the mice experience two different events, when mice encounter a previously experienced event for a second time (memory recall), there is an elevation in the reactivation level of the DGC population that was activated during the initial event learning. Although this level of reactivation did not rise above chance
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from comparing reactivation patterns across different experimental conditions.

claim: A weak but significant correlation was detected between the reactivation index and behavioral performance in the dentate gyrus.
source_text: we detected a weak but significant correlation between the reactivation index and behavioral performance
evidence_reasoning: This is a statistical finding from correlation analysis.

claim: The reactivation of the dentate granule cell population that was activated during learning may contribute to memory recall.
source_text: suggesting that the reactivation of the DGC population that was activated during learning may contribute to memory recall
evidence_reasoning: This is inferred from the correlation between reactivation and behavior.

claim: CA1 neurons activated during contextual memory formation were preferentially reactivated upon retrieval of the memorized contextual information, even though the context was later associated with an emotional value.
source_text: In contrast to the DG, CA1 neurons activated during contextual memory formation were preferentially reactivated upon retrieval of the memorized contextual information, even though the context was later associated with an emotional value (in our case, fear)
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the fear conditioning experiments.

claim: The hippocampus can automatically encode ongoing events, whereas the association of these events with an emotional value occurs in other brain structures, such as amygdala.
source_text: This observation is in agreement with the notion that the hippocampus can automatically encode ongoing events, whereas the association of these events with an emotional value occurs in other brain structures, such as amygdala (Rudy and O'Reilly, 2001; Stote and Fanselow, 2004)
evidence_reasoning: This is an established concept from prior theoretical and experimental work.

claim: Similar reactivations of CA1 neurons were observed when animals were re-exposed to a previously experienced environment without a change in emotional value.
source_text: Indeed, similar reactivations of CA1 neurons were observed when animals were re-exposed to a previously experienced environment without a change in emotional value
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the neutral context exposure experiment.

claim: Equivalent levels of immediate early gene induction were found in the hippocampus by subjecting mice to contextual fear conditioning training or by exposing mice to the context without foot shocks.
source_text: Similar to our findings, equivalent levels of IEG induction were found in the hippocampus by subjecting mice to contextual fear conditioning training (context exposure plus foot shocks) or by exposing mice to the context without foot shocks (Ramamoorthi et al., 2011; Liu et al., 2012)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior studies showing similar hippocampal activity regardless of emotional valence.

claim: Neurons in the basal lateral amygdala activated during fear conditioning training are preferentially reactivated by the retrieval of contextual fear memory.
source_text: the role of the amygdala in the association of events with an emotional value is supported by the findings that neurons in the basal lateral amygdala activated during fear conditioning training are preferentially reactivated by the retrieval of contextual fear memory (Reijmers et al., 2007)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior work on amygdala function in fear memory.

claim: Post-learning elimination of amygdala neurons involved in fear learning erases the fear memory.
source_text: and that post-learning elimination of amygdala neurons involved in fear learning erases the fear memory (Han et al., 2009)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior experimental work on amygdala's role in fear memory.

claim: No linear correlation was detected between CA1 reactivation and freezing behavior of mice under the experimental conditions.
source_text: Unlike in the DG, we were not able to detect a linear correlation between the CA1 reactivation and freezing behavior of mice under our experimental conditions
evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from correlation analysis.

claim: The reactivation of CA1 may be necessary but not sufficient to drive the behavior under certain circumstances.
source_text: It is possible that the reactivation of CA1 may be necessary but not sufficient to drive the behavior under certain circumstance (e.g. when the input difference is detected by the DG/CA3 network)
evidence_reasoning: This is a speculative explanation for the lack of correlation between CA1 reactivation and behavior.

claim: Remapping in CA1 is less sensitive to changes in environmental cues compared to CA3 and the dentate gyrus.
source_text: Given that remapping in CA1 is less sensitive to changes in environmental cues compared to CA3 and the DG (Leutgeb et al., 2004, 2007)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior physiological studies on remapping properties.

claim: CA1 is dispensable for spatial pattern separation.
source_text: In addition, behavioral studies have shown that CA1 is dispensable for spatial pattern separation (Gilbert et al., 2001)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior behavioral work on the role of CA1 in pattern separation.

claim: The same CA1 ensemble used for memory formation is likely to be reactivated by recall of the same memory trace.
source_text: our findings are not only consistent with previous reports that CA1 is critically involved in both encoding and retrieval of spatial and contextual information but also suggest that the same CA1 ensemble used for memory formation is likely to be reactivated by recall of the same memory trace
evidence_reasoning: This is a conclusion drawn from the preferential reactivation data in CA1.

claim: The TetTag transgenic mice contain two transgenes: one expressing tTA by Fos promoter and the other expressing dox-insensitive tTA* and tau-LacZ downstream of the tetO promoter.
source_text: The TetTag transgenic mice contain two transgenes: one transgene expresses tTA by Fos promoter and the other transgene expresses dox-insensitive tTA* and tau-LacZ downstream of the tetO promoter
evidence_reasoning: This describes the genetic composition of the mouse model used.

claim: The density of dentate granule cells in C57BL/6 mice is 1.10 ± 0.04/1000 μm³.
source_text: Previous reports have shown that the density of DGCs in C57BL/6 mice is 1.10 ± 0.04/1000 μm3 (Kempermann et al., 1998)
evidence_reasoning: This cites prior anatomical measurements.

claim: The density of dentate granule cells in TetTag mice was measured to be 1.14 ± 0.02/1000 μm³.
source_text: The DGC density calculated from this measurement was 1.14 ± 0.02/1000 μm3
evidence_reasoning: This is a quantitative measurement from the current study.

claim: The pre-exposure-immediate shock protocol allows identical environmental inputs to be delivered at pre-exposure and re-exposure.
source_text: In addition, identical environmental inputs could be delivered at the pre-exposure and re-exposure
evidence_reasoning: This explains an advantage of the chosen behavioral paradigm.
